`SnlInteractionDriver` receives hover, leave, click and Ctrl-click context, including semantic tree paths. Display layout is not identity: a repeated SVG placement must still identify the correct child. Binding hover must reach the actual binder, not merely another token with equal text.

`EntryPreviewProvider` renders recursive Entry previews from Macro source Entries through the supplied drivers. Shared hover/popover mechanisms own opening, pinning, dismissal and viewport placement. Consumers should inherit those defaults unless deliberately changing policy, rather than copying their current timing constants.

Entry title/source/preview actions are injected host callbacks. Block hover, Ctrl-hover and Ctrl-click remain distinct from nested semantic/title/button actions; a nested action must not be dispatched again as a block Ctrl-click. Ctrl pressed after entering the block must update the hover mode. Callback failures are contained by the renderer rather than tearing down the Entry.

**Acceptance requirements:** test a real semantic-node hover, a bound variable and its binder, nested preview creation, pin/dismiss behavior, Ctrl-before/after-enter, theme switching while a preview is open, and unmount cleanup. Passing only static CSS or event-handler unit tests is not evidence that an installed host behaves correctly.
